verdict.rationale: Commercial terms are transparent (per-token pricing, rate limits, versioning) and there are concrete data-handling commitments ('not trained on customer requests or responses', DPA/Privacy Policy/ZDR referenced), but there is no evidence of an actual usage policy spelling out prohibited uses or acceptable-use restrictions anywhere in the docs. Missing for 10: an explicit prohibited-uses/acceptable-use policy, plain-language summary of legal terms (DPA/Privacy Policy content itself), and any founder-facing guidance on disallowed applications.
